summary: Sony Group filed a Form 6-K (its US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) attaching an English translation of its monthly Share Buyback Report to Japan's Kanto Finance Bureau (a Tokyo Stock Exchange disclosure), covering September 1-30, 2026. Under the May 8, 2026 board authorization, Sony may repurchase up to 230,000,000 shares or ¥500,000,000,000 through May 10, 2027 via open-market discretionary trading. September repurchases totaled 6,892,400 shares for ¥26,005,851,887, bringing cumulative buybacks to 74,473,700 shares (¥263,357,992,192), 32.38% of the share cap and 52.67% of the yen cap; treasury stock stands at 125,470,354 shares versus 5,965,316,326 issued. Watch the remaining authorization pace, yen purchase average, and any buyback ceiling adjustment.
